answer: To deter Sybil attacks in an agent economy monitoring a citrus grove, farm terrace, and river basin, nodes require remote attestation from discrete secure enclaves. Agents verify actions using cryptographic signatures derived from on-chip physical unclonable functions. Attackers must purchase dedicated cryptographic silicon per identity, imposing verifiable hardware procurement costs. However, physical side-channel leakage or compromised vendor keys can permit identity spoofing.
